description: This course examines a number of foundational texts of the medieval legend of King Arthur.
Students study the specific political and socio-cultural contexts that produced these works, in
addition to later works that reflect the ongoing appeal of Arthurian myth. Students will both
analyze and imitate to deepen their understanding of Arthurian texts as creative acts whose form
and style reveal their creator's fears, desires, self-image, and social status.
